title: Arabian Horse Definition 2026
covers: Arabian horse; Purebred Arabian; Stud Book; Register
note: WAHO defines a Purebred Arabian horse through appearance in a WAHO-accepted Purebred Arabian Stud Book or Register. Use for breed identity, not race eligibility by itself.

title: What Is Harness Racing? / What Is a Standardbred?
note: USTA identifies Standardbred as the specific horse breed used in harness racing and describes the breed. Registry scope is North American; the core breed term is not treated as a jurisdiction-specific synonym.

title: 競走 — 海外競馬英和辞典
note: JRA overseas dictionary maps maiden to 未出走・未勝利 and judge to 決勝審判委員. Use with jurisdiction rules for exact eligibility semantics.

title: J — 海外競馬英和辞典
note: JRA maps juvenile to 若馬・2歳馬 and judge to 決勝審判委員, demonstrating the age sense while preserving jurisdiction dependence.

title: 競馬に関わる人々
covers: Apprentice jockey; Groom; Judge; Breeder; racing personnel
note: JRA defines 見習騎手 and 厩務員 and describes 決勝審判 and other racing participants. English labels are corroborated separately where necessary.

title: Jockeys — Licensing
covers: Apprentice jockey; Conditional jockey; Professional jockey; Amateur rider
note: Current BHA licensing page explicitly distinguishes Apprentice and Conditional Jockeys from full professional and amateur riders.

title: Appointment of the Clerk of the Course
note: BHA instruction requires appointment of a Clerk of the Course for each meeting and assigns raceday duties under the Rules.

title: レースの種類、条件など
note: JRA explains handicap weight as determined by handicappers and separately defines 未勝利 status. English Handicapper label is treated as the generic functional role.

title: 開催執務委員
note: JRA lists the official raceday functions including 発走委員, 決勝審判委員, ハンデキャップ作成委員 and 獣医委員. Use as Japanese institutional evidence, not global title equivalence.

title: 馬、獣医 — 海外競馬英和辞典
note: JRA maps veterinarian to 獣医師 and farrier to 装蹄師; also records the polysemous horse sense.

title: Race Comments
note: Equibase standardized chart-comment vocabulary directly defines Bumped and Checked in North American Thoroughbred charts. Other trip terms remain candidate unless separately confirmed.

title: Point-to-Point Regulations — Appendix R Equine Headgear
covers: Blinkers; Cheek Pieces; Hood; Visor; Eyeshield; Eye Cover
note: BHA Appendix R distinguishes headgear types visually and explicitly differentiates visor from blinkers. Supports GB headgear semantics.

title: 競馬で使用する様々な道具
covers: Tongue tie; Shadow roll; Cheekpieces; Bridle
note: JRA defines 舌縛り, シャドーロール and チークピーシーズ and describes 頭絡. Use with the English dictionary source for label mapping.

title: 馬装具 — 海外競馬英和辞典
covers: Bit; Bridle; Cheek pieces; Hood; Reins; Shadow roll; Tongue tie
note: JRA provides English-to-Japanese mappings for common horse gear. Pair with equipment glossary or authority rules when a functional definition is claimed.

title: 騎手装具他 — 海外競馬英和辞典
note: JRA maps whip to ムチ and provides standard rider-equipment mappings.

title: Mandatory Trackwork Rider Accreditation
covers: Trackwork; Jump-outs; Slow Work; Fast Work
note: Racing Victoria currently accredits trackwork riders for Slow Work, Fast Work and Jump Outs and requires specific competencies for each level.

title: Racing Calendar
note: Current Racing Victoria calendar publishes a dedicated 2026 Jump-Outs schedule, corroborating operational use.

title: USTA Rule Book — Qualifying Race definition
note: Rule 4.147 defines a Qualifying Race as a race in which a horse establishes ability to participate at a race meeting under qualifying standards. Current USTA regulatory services corroborate ongoing qualifier usage.

title: 生産、育成関係、飼糧など
note: JRA defines 繁殖牝馬 as a mare kept for producing foals; supports broodmare semantics.

title: How do I register a foal with AQHA?
note: AQHA current guidance requires a registration application and registered parents for an American Quarter Horse foal. Supports registration semantics within AQHA scope.

title: IABRW Article 12 — Definition of a Thoroughbred
note: Current IFHA Article 12 identifies the breeder of a Thoroughbred foal as the owner(s) of the mare at foaling and specifies the information required for the foal to be registered. This is a Thoroughbred-rule definition, not a universal breeder ownership rule.

title: Raceday operations and regulation
covers: Starter; Judge; Clerk of the Scales; veterinary and integrity roles
note: BHA describes Starters as starting races to achieve a fair start and Judges as determining finishing order; supports generic role semantics while official titles remain jurisdiction-specific.

title: groom — 海外競馬英和辞典
note: JRA maps groom to 厩務員. Pair with JRA's participant glossary for the daily-care role definition.

title: 調教 — 海外競馬英和辞典
note: JRA's overseas racing dictionary maps breezing to 馬なり, canter to キャンター／駈歩 and handily to 強めの調教. These mappings are retained as regional translation semantics rather than universal workout-code definitions.
